run_tokenize_thai_stdin: run the script to tokenize Thai text piped from stdin using pythainlp word_tokenize
run_tokenize_thai_file: run the script to tokenize Thai text from a file by piping it into stdin
run_tokenize_thai_batch: run the script to tokenize multiple lines of Thai text one at a time from stdin
review_tokenize_thai_script: review the python script that uses pythainlp word_tokenize to tokenize Thai text from stdin
refactor_tokenize_thai_cli: refactor the script to accept a file path argument instead of reading from stdin
